newsitem.title: USA: N.C. Piedmont Triad airport has $8.2 mln surplus.
newsitem.headline: N.C. Piedmont Triad airport has $8.2 mln surplus.

text.p: North Carolina's Piedmont Triad International Airport will end its fiscal year June 30 with a record $8.2 million surplus, the News & Record reported Wednesday.
The airport also projects an $8.1 million surplus for fiscal 1998, which begins July 1, airport Executive Director Ted Johnson told airport authority members.
The authority plans to use the surplus for future expansion, including a $30 million proposal to extend one of its runways in about five years.
The aiport has $79 million of bonds outstanding, and has accumulated $41 million in excess revenues.
